appearance_facts.fact: The pie chart is titled 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe'.
The pie chart is divided into five colored segments.
The largest segment is orange, labeled 'Apple (45%)'.
The second largest segment is red, labeled 'Others (10%)'.
The third largest segment is orange-red, labeled 'Xiaomi (30%)'.
The fourth largest segment is yellow, labeled 'Samsung (15%)'.
The segments are arranged clockwise from the top: Apple, Xiaomi, Samsung, Others.
The chart visually represents market share percentages for each brand.

printed_facts.fact: Apple has a market share of 45%.
Xiaomi has a market share of 30%.
Samsung has a market share of 15%.
Others have a market share of 10%.

public_definitions: The goal is to allocate the premium EU retail promotion budget to the brand with the highest current market share in Europe.
The comparison scope is the current market share of smartphone brands in Europe.
The rule is to select the brand with the highest market share.
